Villa Bon Secour by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 For a quick 2-minute walk to the beach, take the private, paved, pathway. It’s gorgeous! And when you get to the sand, you and your sun-chasing squad get to lounge like royalty on a pair of complimentary beach chairs, with an umbrella, available March through October. Welcome to Villa Bon Secour, tucked away in a private gated community. Out back, the enchanting private pool includes lounge chairs, a grill, and a dining table for 6. The pool has optional heat for an extra charge. Inside, the one-story beach house has a spacious, open living area.

The wonderful kitchen seats 4, the dining room seats 6, and includes a sunroom for additional seating that walks out to the pool area. A primary bedroom, king, has a private bath and TV as does a guest room, queen, and bunk room. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 300 steps to beach - 3 bedroom, 3 bath - 1600 sq ft - Propane grill - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55 per night, contact Oversee for details) - Set of seasonal, complimentary beach chairs provided (March - October) Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; private bath, TV - Queen in 1st floor guest room; private bath, TV - Twin over full bunk in 1st floor bunk room; private bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
